title: Zephyr: guard budget validation
description: Validate guard budget for Zephyr C. Acceptance: Correct for target hardware specs.
notes: Implemented Zephyr/C CCP-7 guard budget validation for G >= B_i+B_j+J_i+J_j+P+M in tdma.c/header. Required-time addition is checked term-by-term and fails closed on uint64 overflow. Added a focused standalone hardened test covering ccp7_holdover canonical 50 ms sufficient/equality/insufficient cases, the target SF10 guard boundary, zero/equality behavior, and overflow attacks. Added accurate nullability to the pre-existing TDMA declarations so the focused -Werror build can consume the public header. AppleClang/UBSan ctest passed 1/1; git diff --check and clang-format dry-run passed.
close_reason: Implemented and validated overflow-safe CCP-7 guard-budget sufficiency for Zephyr C against canonical target parameters.
